summary: Newaygo County, Michigan, lookout in the Manistee National Forest; only a directory entry was found, with no build, staffing, fire or site history.

notes_for_editor: Only one source was found: a Michigan Fire Towers directory entry with name, county, forest and coordinates. The story is below the 120-word floor because nothing else could be sourced; the editor may prefer to hold it. Two WebSearch queries returned the same directory entry, a topo-map listing for a 'Beaver Lookout Tower' in Newaygo County (anyplaceamerica.com, HTTP 403 when read, not verified as this tower), and Manistee forest histories that do not name this tower. The Huron-Manistee National Forest history page and a 1965 Manistee forest fire post from the Newaygo County museum were checked and not used, since neither names this tower. The 'U.S.F.S.' in the name is the directory's wording and is not independently confirmed. Leads for a fuller story: Huron-Manistee National Forest heritage or lookout records, and Michigan DNR tower inventories.
